# Publication fixture

publication.zip is a real two-frame export from the ordinary shiqu-docker browser encoder after invisible watermarking was withdrawn on 2026-11-02. It uses isolated solid-color artwork and a synthetic story, with public test attribution, saved original text, a 12px bottom credit, XMP and hashes. It contains no invisible watermark or token. No user library or paid generation was used. It is test data, never a selected/published story. Regenerate using the production export rather than hand-editing this compatibility fixture.
